text:
[LCMP.2.2.1] For each `(aggregation, time-model, accuracy)`
triple in a `series` declaration per [LSER.13], the compiler
must emit:

- The triple as the author wrote it.
- The chosen backing class (named per
  [LSER.18.1]).
- The state cost class (e.g. `O(1)`, `O(window-rate)`,
  `O((1/ε) log²(W))`).
- Whether this triple shares a backing with another triple in
  the same `series` block (coalescing per [LSER.13.3]).
